title: Canonical data foundation
reader_question: What are the issuer's canonical figures, definitions and instruments, period by period, with every figure cited?

inputs.why: the source inventory: which files are readable Issuer Sources about this issuer, their periods and their traps
the financial statements, debt notes, term sheets and pro forma capitalisation the figures come from
period financial statements (an offering memorandum or lender presentation holds them for a private or 144A issuer); without any, CP-1 has nothing to register and is Blocked
instrument identifiers, agency ratings and a listed equity value
the entity and date in scope, and the new tranches' ids (`NEW-<n>`) to register as facilities

process: File Gate & Source Validation. Gate: no financial sources -> Blocked; do not proceed. Read `handoffs/CP-0.md`: its `cp0.source_inventory` is the source register; use only files it lists with `entity_match` Yes and `readable` Yes. Evidence hierarchy: Tier 1 (Audited FS) > 2a (Unaudited w/ auditor) > 2b (w/o) > 2c (Lender/sponsor) > 2d (Rating) > 3a (Internal) > 3b (External). Record the result as the first `## Analysis` paragraph, `Sources`: each file used with its tier and what it supplies (statements, notes, periods), then one sufficiency line each for IS, CFS, BS and KPIs naming the periods covered and the periods missing; each missing period is a gap row with its downstream effect. A passing gate is not that record. Do NOT classify from filenames alone; inspect content. Source-first discipline: complete before any extraction.

Entity/Period Scope (`cp1.entity_profile`). Establish issuer entity scope: issuer name (legal entity), borrower, guarantor group, restricted group; note ambiguity. Establish all reporting periods: annual, interim, quarterly; record FY end (`fiscal_year_end` as `MM-DD`), stub/short periods. Record reporting basis: currency, unit, consolidation perimeter, accounting basis. Entity names from content, not filenames. If consolidation perimeter differs across sources, flag it. Where a consolidated issuer contains a captive finance company, financing subsidiary or financial-services segment, show the perimeters separately; never substitute one perimeter for another. Subsequent events: the reporting period ends at the balance-sheet date; scan every source for events after that date (subsequent-events note, dividends declared, refinancings, buybacks, disposals) and flag each with the event date under `## Gaps`; never blend it into period figures.

Normalization. Establish canonical basis: single currency, single unit, single perimeter, single accounting basis. Record every adjustment (what, source, before/after, rationale, affected periods) in `## Analysis`. Flag incomplete normalization: carry the figure with a limitation. Once established, the basis applies to ALL subsequent steps; currency/unit switching is prohibited. Unresolvable accounting basis differences must be flagged, not silently chosen.

Period register (`cp1.model_period_register`; `period_type` QUARTER, YTD, FY, LTM or PERIOD_END). Direct reported discrete quarter has priority. Calculate Q2 as H1-Q1 and Q3 as 9M-H1 only when direct quarters are absent. Reported unaudited Q4 remains independent. Direct reported FY is not replaced by a sum of quarters. Flow LTM = latest FY + current YTD - prior comparable YTD: register the LTM period (`LTM_Q<n>_<yyyy>`) and let the Model derive its figures; a derived period with a missing component is `—`. Balance-sheet LTM means the latest period end. Ids `FY<yyyy>`, `H1_<yyyy>` (and `9M_<yyyy>`, `Q<n>_<yyyy>`); `day_count` = end - start + 1; `fiscal_quarter` only on a quarter or year-to-date row.

Period coverage. Register every period the pack carries, including the oldest fiscal year the filings present (a prior-year column, a multi-year summary or comparative statements), in `cp1.model_period_register` and the account register. If the Handoff size cap forces trimming, shorten register prose (locators, notes, descriptions) before dropping any period or metric row.

Income Statement, Cash Flow Statement and Balance Sheet coverage (`cp1.model_account_register`, one row per `metric_id` and `period_id`). Extract + normalize the full IS, CFS and BS for every available period on the Step 3 basis. Controlled metric IDs: `revenue`, `cogs`, `gross_profit`, `opex_including_da`, `ebit`, `depreciation_amortization`, `ebitda`, `adjusted_ebitda`, `cash_interest_paid`, `cash_lease_payments`, `cash_taxes_paid`, `cfo_ncfo`, `working_capital_change`, `capex_and_intangible_investment`, `acquisitions_disposals`, `net_debt_issue_repay`, `net_equity_issue_repay`, `dividends_paid`, `other_investing_financing`, `net_cash_change`, `cash_and_equivalents`, `rcf_commitment`, `rcf_drawn`, `senior_secured_debt`, `unsecured_debt`, `total_debt`, `net_accounts_receivable`, `inventory`, `accounts_payable`, `pretax_income`, `income_tax_expense`, `operating_lease_cost`, `lease_payments_in_financing`, `interest_paid_in_financing`. Four IDs record where the issuer put lease and interest cash, so the Model can bridge between accounting bases; each is emitted where a source states it, outflows negative: `cash_lease_payments` is the cash rent paid under leases and lease-like financing obligations (failed sale-leasebacks, master leases) whichever line carries it (operating, interest or financing), from the cash-flow statement, its supplemental disclosure or the lease note, one row per cash-flow period a source states it (rent that appears in `## Analysis` without this row is a miss), `operating_lease_cost` is the lease cost recognised inside operating expenses (ASC 842 operating lease cost; under IFRS 16 only short-term and variable lease expense), `lease_payments_in_financing` the lease cash the issuer classified in financing activities (IFRS 16 principal; ASC 842 finance-lease principal), `interest_paid_in_financing` the interest paid that the issuer classified in financing activities (an IFRS option; `0` under US GAAP). Income taxes paid that the issuer classified outside operating activities have no metric ID: record the classification as a limitation under `## Gaps`. Cash interest and cash tax mean cash paid, not accrued expense. `cfo_ncfo` accepts reported CFO, OCF, NCFO or net cash provided by operating activities. Use the canonical sign convention: inflows/positive balances positive and outflows negative. EBITDA not stated -> derive from components (`calculation_status` CALCULATED). Do NOT fabricate missing items: non-derivable = `—` + gap. When the issuer reports expenses by nature and no cost of revenue, do not invent one: leave the `cogs` and `gross_profit` rows as not reported (`—`, `calculation_status` NOT AVAILABLE) with the reason, and register operating expenses (including depreciation and amortization) as stated. `calculation_status`: VERIFIED, CALCULATED, ESTIMATED, PROXY, NOT CALCULABLE, PARTIAL, CONFLICTED, NOT AVAILABLE. `source_id` holds the citation marker (`[C<n>]`), `source_locator` its locator.

Issuer headline totals and liquidity deductions. For each adjusted measure the issuer reconciles (Adjusted EBITDA, free cash flow, liquidity), read its reconciliation table top to bottom for EVERY period you register and write down the final total line, after every deduction. Register that line, never an earlier subtotal. Each subtotal that sits above a deduction goes in `cp1.definition_conflicts` with both citations and the deduction that separates them. Where the liquidity table or note shows deductions from availability (letters of credit, regulatory or reserve amounts, restricted cash, minimum-liquidity requirements), record each deduction with its citation in `## Analysis` and use the net availability in the liquidity conclusion; do not fold a deduction into cash or the facility drawn amount without saying so.

Debt basis. Total Debt = balance-sheet carrying value: current portion of debt + long-term debt, net of unamortized issuance costs and discounts. Gross principal outstanding is NEVER the canonical basis for Total Debt, Net Debt or any leverage ratio; where it is disclosed and materially different, log BOTH figures in `cp1.definition_conflicts`. The account metric `total_debt` excludes lease liabilities. Debt classification by seniority is critical for CP-3: not disclosed -> `—`; do NOT estimate. Pension/lease obligations separated from financial debt where possible. A material non-debt, non-interest-bearing liability funding operations (customer deposits, deferred revenue, supplier finance) is credit-relevant working-capital float: size, trend and obligation in `## Analysis`, never ordinary payables.

Segment, EBITDA and KPI registers. Emit one stable `segment_id` per identified business unit and one row per applicable period in `cp1.segment_revenue_schedule`; retain exact issuer labels and order by `display_priority`; `segment_type` is OPERATING_SEGMENT or CORPORATE_ELIMINATION, at most one corporate/elimination row per period. If no business-unit revenue schedule is disclosed, emit an empty segment table; do not imply a zero segment sum. When segments exist, map every stable `segment_id` exactly once to `DIVISION_1`, `DIVISION_2` or `DIVISION_3` in `cp1.cp_model_segment_allocation`. `cp1.operating_kpi_schedule` contains operating measures (users, subscribers, RGUs, connections, backlog, homes passed, churn, ARPU), never revenue, EBITDA, leverage or other financial ratios; `value_type` PERIOD_END, PERIOD_FLOW or RATE.

Adjusted EBITDA bridge (`cp1.adjusted_ebitda_bridge`). Emit one stable `addback_id` per separately identified add-back and one row per applicable period; retain the exact `addback_label`; add-back priorities must be unique. `addback_classification` is one of RESTRUCTURING, SBC, COST_SAVINGS, RUN_RATE, SYNERGY, TRANSACTION_COSTS, OTHER_EXPLICIT; `realization_status` is independently REALIZED, UNREALIZED or NOT_STATED. Do not infer realization from the nature classification; split an item into stable IDs when only part has been realized. Every OTHER_EXPLICIT line must be source-supported and is never a plug. Do not manufacture empty slots: if the issuer explicitly reports no add-backs, emit an empty bridge. Show source vs normalized one-offs; label normalization.

Debt facility register (`cp1.debt_facility_register`). Model debt totals use carrying values; `drawn_amount` and `commitment` are retained separately and are not substitutes. When instrument-level carrying values are not disclosed, retain the disclosed principal or translated balance on each named facility as its `carrying_value` and add the separately disclosed aggregate financing-cost, discount or premium amount as one `DEBT ADJUSTMENT` row (`facility_type` `DEBT ADJUSTMENT`, spelled so; `lease_classification` NOT_LEASE). Only that adjustment row may be negative; any other negative `carrying_value` makes `rbot model` exit 1. Every row requires `facility_name`, currency, interest cost or an explicit `Not stated`, maturity, `source_id` and `source_locator`. `secured_status` SECURED, UNSECURED or NOT_STATED; `seniority` SUPER_SENIOR, SENIOR, SENIOR_SUBORDINATED, SUBORDINATED, JUNIOR or NOT_STATED; `lease_classification` FINANCE_LEASE, OPERATING_LEASE, NOT_LEASE or NOT_STATED. NOT_STATED is not affirmative evidence of a security or ranking. Do not infer security or ranking from the instrument name. `rate_type` FIXED, FLOATING or NOT_STATED; `reference_rate` SOFR, TERM_SOFR, EURIBOR, SONIA, NONE or NOT_STATED; `spread_bps` an integer basis-point spread; `floor_bps` an integer floor, `—` when no floor is stated; `fixed_rate` a decimal percent coupon for FIXED; `annual_amortisation` in the register's currency and unit, `0` for a bullet, `—` only when not stated. A term no source states is NOT_STATED or `—`; it is never inferred from the instrument name (a "Term Loan B" is not evidence of FLOATING). A new tranche of the Run Brief is a row with `facility_id` its `tranche_id`, `period_id` the LTM and `carrying_value` `0`, its terms from the term sheet; Price Talk is not a final spread.

Pro forma adjustment register (`cp1.pro_forma_adjustment_register`): adjustments a source states for activity outside the reported LTM (a lender presentation for a primary transaction, or a post-period acquisition, disposal or refinancing). When no source states one, the table is empty; never construct an adjustment the source does not state. `classification` is one of ACQUISITION, DISPOSAL, REFINANCING, SUBSEQUENT_EVENT, LENDER_UPDATE, OTHER_EXPLICIT; `period_id` names the LTM period; `metric_id` is one of `revenue`, `ebitda`, `adjusted_ebitda`, `cash_interest_paid`, `cash_and_equivalents`, `total_debt`, or a facility's `facility_id` prefixed `facility:`; `value` follows the account register's sign convention. The Model adds each `facility:` row into total debt, so `total_debt` is only for a change no facility row carries. Pro forma interest only from a source, never from Price Talk.

Instrument identity and equity value (`cp1.instrument_identity`, `cp1.equity_value`), for CP-3, FIT and the capital structure. One identity row per facility of the latest balance date and per new tranche: `debt_type` from its scale, identifiers (`bloomberg_id`, `isin`, `cusip`) and agency ratings as a dated Market Context or offering document states them, `call_schedule` as the indenture writes it, `listed_market` Yes when a Market Level exists; `—` where none is stated. `cp1.equity_value` only from a listed market capitalisation in Market Context.

Reconciliation (`cp1.reconciliation_checks`). Cross-check internal consistency: segment revenue to reported revenue, EBITDA bridge, adjusted EBITDA bridge at exact `addback_id` granularity, CFO identity, debt totals (`DEBT_TOTAL`: the sum of the carrying values of the NOT_LEASE and NOT_STATED rows, plus any `DEBT ADJUSTMENT` row, equals `total_debt`), NCF to cash movement and reported FY to quarterly sum. A reported-FY difference can be WARN when audited and unaudited bases differ and the explanation is explicit. It is not silently forced to zero. `status` PASS, WARN or FAIL. Include a check `ADJ_EBITDA_HEADLINE` per registered period: expected = the issuer's final headline total line copied with its citation, actual = the account register value; FAIL when they differ or when the expected value is a subtotal above a deduction. Include one check or conflict row for every outside figure that bears on debt or liquidity (a press-release round number, the CP-0 Handoff debt figure, an arranger or pro forma figure): reconcile it to a register value by named components, or leave it open as a conflict row and gap. State a basis for an outside figure only when its source states it.

Definition Conflict Register (`cp1.definition_conflicts`). Review all metrics: issuer def vs. canonical? Sources disagree? Definition changed across periods? Log each conflict: metric, canonical def, issuer def, periods, materiality, resolution. Common conflict areas: EBITDA (add-backs, exclusions, management vs. audited), Debt (leases, pensions, drawn facilities), FCF (levered vs. unlevered, WC inclusion), Capex (capitalized items, maint vs. growth), Net Debt (restricted cash, ST investments). Multi-figure events: one economic event with different figures across statements -> extract ALL, label statement roles, ONE register row explaining the differences. Silent definition acceptance is NOT valid; with no conflict, say so in `## Analysis`.

Evidence-to-Risk-to-Credit Analysis (`## Analysis`). Synthesis only: no new data extraction; every figure traces to the tables; every statement issuer-specific, no generic credit commentary. Write one paragraph per material finding, headed by the finding's name and built of three labelled parts: `Evidence:` the figures with their citations; `Mechanism:` how they change a creditor's cash or claim; `Implication:` what follows for leverage, coverage, liquidity, the registers or monitoring. A finding paragraph without all three labels is incomplete. Required finding paragraphs where the pack supports them: headline totals; debt basis and every obligation outside `total_debt`; leverage and coverage trajectory; cash-flow quality; each segment change the issuer explains; liquidity adequacy, net of the step 7 deductions; the working-capital float; subsequent events (date, effect, why excluded from period figures); multi-figure events (which figure serves which purpose); data-quality and definition risks. Trajectory: CP-1 computes no ratio; state the direction and size of change of `total_debt`, `adjusted_ebitda`, `cash_interest_paid` and `cash_lease_payments` across the registered periods, and quote any leverage or coverage ratio the issuer itself reports with its stated basis and citation; the Model computes the ratios. Causes: before writing a cause for any change in a segment, margin or cash flow, read the issuer's MD&A explanation of that change; state its primary cause first, in its order and with citation; a cause the issuer does not give is labelled `Analyst inference` and never displaces the stated one. Three closing paragraphs have their own form. `Covenants`: every financial test the pack states (leverage, interest or fixed-charge coverage, rent or revenue-to-rent, minimum liquidity, incurrence tests), each with its level, the facility it binds, its citation and whether its definitions are in the pack; a test the pack states and this list omits is a miss. `Counter-case`: name the one assumption of the base reading on which the creditor's view most depends (which perimeter of debt and EBITDA the covenants and the Model use, whether an obligation outside `total_debt` is debt-like, whether a cash-flow source is durable), then argue the opposite reading against it: the pack evidence for it, the document fact in or outside the pack that would make it win, and how conviction and monitoring change if it does; a list of favourable facts is not a counter-case. `Downside`: the causal path canon requires (starting condition, first break, transmission, consequence, observable trigger), naming each listed covenant test the stress presses on and which cannot be sized without its definitions.

Coverage Gate. Consolidate ALL gaps from ALL prior steps under `## Gaps`: every `—` in a value-bearing column with its table, row, column and the reason; a `—` in a column where none applies (`component_period_ids` on a reported period, `fiscal_quarter` on a fiscal year, `floor_bps` with no floor, `fixed_rate` on a FLOATING row, `spread_bps` on a FIXED row) is not a gap. `qa_status`: Pass when complete; Restricted with gaps or limitations; Blocked when no financial sources. Every gap row states the cause, the affected table, row and period, the downstream effect, and the named document or filing that would lift it; a row without a lifting source is incomplete.
prohibited: No independent credit recommendation or unsupported normalization.
Unsupported financial assertion: must cite source file + locator; no bare claims.
Conflicting source definitions: do NOT reconcile silently; log them in `cp1.definition_conflicts`.
Missing financial data: store `—` + log gap; do NOT fabricate or infer. Null is not zero unless the source explicitly states zero.
Promotional / equity-optimism language: creditor-focused institutional tone only.
No ratio, KPI or LTM figure the Model computes: register its inputs.
